item.title: Bank credit · announced · @thsottiaux
item.description:
Bank credit · announced Timing: As a small token to apologize for the mistake, we’ll be adding one banked reset for everyone on Go, Plus, Pro, and Business Note: 原文没有可确定的时间 Evidence: As a small token to apologize for the mistake, we’ll be adding one banked reset for everyone on Go, Plus, Pro, and Business
We made a billing mistake at launch of GPT-6.2 that incorrectly discounted GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol usage for most users.
We’ve fixed this now, so the same work will use more of your plan’s usage allowance. Comparing to last week, you will reach your limits 40% faster on GPT-6.2 Astra and 25% faster on Sol. You should still see these go further in usage compared to 6 Astra and 6.1 Sol. Other models weren’t affected, and we won’t charge you for the difference on past usage.
As a small token to apologize for the mistake, we’ll be adding one banked reset for everyone on Go, Plus, Pro, and Business.

item.title: Bank credit · announced · @thsottiaux
item.description:
Bank credit · announced Timing: Lands end of day Note: Banked reset was promised by end of day, but no safe exact landing time is stated. The separate 8pm PT time is an eligibility cutoff for account creation or upgrade, not the bank-credit landing time. Evidence: we will do the full banked reset today too for all Plus, Pro and Business users
Because we are beyond happy to have Astra rolled out today ahead of schedule and you have been super patient with us (not really, but it’s ok!)… we will do the full banked reset today too for all Plus, Pro and Business users. Lands end of day. Happy Astra day and enjoy a phenomenal weekend. PS: If you create the account or upgrade before 8pm PT you will get it too. Still time!
